text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s of option a. The SUV is now floating in the brown water below the stone ledge with a reflection beneath it and a white wake curl behind its right side; it drifts slowly leftward under the large tree. At about 15.4 s the framing tightens. The pale stone ledge still runs edge to edge across the frame and its lower boundary against the water reads as one long near-horizontal line. The vertical drop and pale right-edge rocks seen earlier are no longer in frame after 15.4 s. No white water at a lip is distinguishable in these samples.
